regions.today: A mix of cloud of clear spells, with the best of the sunny spells across the northern half of the province. Outbreaks of rain and drizzle will spread from the west through the afternoon and evening, but will be very patchy. Highs of 13 to 15 degrees.
regions.tonight: Cloudy with patchy outbreaks of light rain and drizzle. Light westerly or variable breezes will veer northerly overnight. Feeling cooler further north with lows of 2 to 4 degrees, warmer further south with lows of 5 to 9 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly dry and clear on Saturday with cloudier conditions at first in the southeast. Sunny spells will develop through the day. Highs of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate northerly winds.
